question: The cost price of an article is ₹450.The trader marks it at ₹630 and sells it by giving 12.5% discount on the marked price. His gain percent is:
solution:
Given:

The cost price of an article is ₹450.

The trader marks it at ₹630.

Discount = 12.5%

Concept used:

Profit% = {(Selling Price - Cost Price) over Cost Price} times 100\%

Selling price = Marked Price - Marked Price × Discount%

Calculation:

The selling price of the article

⇒ 630 - 630 × 12.5%

⇒ 630 - 78.75

⇒ 551.25

Now, his gain% = {{551.25 - 450} over 450} times 100\%

⇒ {{101.25} over 450} times 100\% = 22.5%

∴ His gain percentage is 22.5%.
